verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that connects AI assistants to its platform. Through it, agents can understand the customer schema, build audiences, create and analyze journeys, manage and create syncs, and analyze performance; Ad Studio customers can also generate ad creatives. The docs include example natural-language prompts, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page. Missing for 10: connection and setup specifics (transport, auth flow, client configuration steps) are not evidenced beyond a note about scoping API keys for AI tools, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
